description: This file defines an internal sealed class 'MigrationContext' used within the Orleans runtime for managing serialization state, buffer management, and context during migration processes. It implements several interfaces for context and buffer writing, and handles byte buffers, key-value indexing, and serialization operations.

classes.name: MigrationContext
classes.description: A class managing serialization buffers and context during migration within Orleans, supporting adding, retrieving, and enumerating key-value pairs with associated byte data.

classes.name: MigrationContext.SerializationHooks
classes.description: A nested class providing a hook for deserialization to reinitialize the session pool.

methods.name: AddBytes
methods.description: Adds byte array data associated with a key to the buffer and index.

methods.name: AddBytes<T>
methods.description: Serializes a value using a provided writer action and adds it under a key.

methods.name: TryAddValue<T>
methods.description: Attempts to serialize a value and add it to the buffer if it does not already exist for the given key.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of buffer resources, resetting and clearing the buffer.

methods.name: TryGetBytes
methods.description: Retrieves byte data associated with a key as a sequence.

methods.name: TryGetValue<T>
methods.description: Attempts to deserialize and retrieve a value associated with a key.
